items.source: Create a CharacterEncodingFilter for the given encoding.
items.translation: 为给定的编码创建一个CharacterEncodingFilter。

items.source: encoding - the encoding to apply
items.translation: encoding - 要应用的编码

items.source: Create a default CharacterEncodingFilter, with the encoding to be set via setEncoding(String).
items.translation: 创建一个默认的 `CharacterEncodingFilter`，其编码将通过 setEncoding(String) 设置。

items.source: This is the equivalent to setting both setForceRequestEncoding(boolean) and setForceResponseEncoding(boolean).
items.translation: 这相当于同时设置 `setForceRequestEncoding(boolean)` 和 `setForceResponseEncoding(boolean)`。

items.source: Whether this encoding will override existing request encodings (and whether it will be applied as default response encoding as well) depends on the "forceEncoding" flag.
items.translation: 此编码是否会覆盖现有的请求编码（以及是否也将作为默认响应编码应用），取决于 `"forceEncoding"` 标志。

items.source: Default is "false", i.e. do not modify the encoding if ServletRequest.getCharacterEncoding() returns a non-null value. Switch this to "true" to enforce the specified encoding in any case, applying it as default response encoding as well.
items.translation: 默认为"false"，即如果ServletRequest.getCharacterEncoding()返回非 null 值，则不修改编码。将此选项切换为"true"以强制在任何情况下应用指定的编码，并将其作为默认响应编码。

items.source: Default is "false", i.e. do not modify the encoding if ServletRequest.getCharacterEncoding() returns a non-null value. Switch this to "true" to enforce the specified encoding in any case.
items.translation: 默认为"false"，即如果`ServletRequest.getCharacterEncoding()`返回非 null 值，则不修改编码。将此选项切换为"true"以强制在任何情况下使用指定的编码。

items.source:
This filter can either apply its encoding if the request does not already
specify an encoding, or enforce this filter's encoding in any case
("forceEncoding"="true"). In the latter case, the encoding will also be
applied as default response encoding (although this will usually be overridden
by a full content type set in the view).
items.translation: 此过滤器可以在请求未指定编码时应用其编码，或者在任何情况下强制使用此过滤器的编码（"forceEncoding"="true"）。在后一种情况下，该编码也将作为默认响应编码进行应用（尽管这通常会被视图中设置的完整 Content-Type 覆盖）。

items.source:
Default is "false", i.e. do not modify the encoding.
Switch this to "true" to enforce the specified encoding
for responses in any case.
items.translation: 默认为"false"，即不修改编码。将此选项切换为"true"以强制在任何情况下对响应使用指定的编码。

items.source: Set whether the configured encoding of this filter is supposed to override existing request and response encodings.
items.translation: 设置此过滤器的配置encoding是否应覆盖现有的请求和响应编码。

items.source: Set whether the configured encoding of this filter is supposed to override existing request encodings.
items.translation: 设置此过滤器的配置encoding是否应覆盖现有的请求编码。

items.source: Set whether the configured encoding of this filter is supposed to override existing response encodings.
items.translation: 设置此过滤器的配置encoding是否应覆盖现有的响应编码。

items.source: Return the configured encoding for requests and/or responses.
items.translation: 返回请求和/或响应的配置编码。

items.source: Return whether the encoding should be forced on requests.
items.translation: 返回是否应在请求上强制使用编码。

items.source: Return whether the encoding should be forced on responses.
items.translation: 返回是否应在响应中强制使用编码。

items.source: forceEncoding - whether the specified encoding is supposed to override existing request and response encodings
items.translation: forceEncoding - 指定编码是否应覆盖现有的请求和响应编码

items.source: forceRequestEncoding - whether the specified encoding is supposed to override existing request encodings
items.translation: forceRequestEncoding - 指定编码是否应覆盖现有的请求编码

items.source: forceResponseEncoding - whether the specified encoding is supposed to override existing response encodings
items.translation: forceResponseEncoding - 指定编码是否应覆盖现有的响应编码

items.source:
Provides HttpServletRequest and HttpServletResponse arguments instead of the
default ServletRequest and ServletResponse ones.
items.translation: 提供 HttpServletRequest 和 HttpServletResponse 参数，而不是默认的 ServletRequest 和 ServletResponse。

items.source: Description copied from class: OncePerRequestFilter
items.translation: 描述从类复制：OncePerRequestFilter

items.source: Same contract as for doFilter, but guaranteed to be just invoked once per request within a single request thread.
items.translation: 与doFilter相同的合同，但保证在单个请求线程中每个请求仅被调用一次。

items.source: Set the encoding to use for requests.
items.translation: 设置请求使用的编码。

items.source: doFilterInternal in class OncePerRequestFilter
items.translation: `doFilterInternal` 在类 `OncePerRequestFilter` 中。

items.translation: Jürgen Hoeller
